title: .eslintrc globals no longer used with 0.7.1 -- works fine with 0.6.2

labels.name: core
labels.description: Relates to ESLint's core APIs and features

labels.name: archived due to age
labels.description: This issue has been archived; please open a new issue for any further discussion

body:
I have a configuration file like this -- we're just using the `no-undef` rule:

```
{
  "env": {
    "browser": true
  },

  "globals": {
    "_gaq": true,
    "_pa": true,
    "$": true,
    "app": true,
    "alert": true,
    "canvg": true,
    "console": true,
    "escape": true,
    "jQuery": true,
    "module": true,
    "require": true,
    "System": true,
    "user": true
  },

  "rules": {
    "no-alert": 0,
    "no-array-constructor": 0,
    "no-bitwise": 0,
    "no-caller": 0,
    "no-catch-shadow": 0,
    "no-comma-dangle": 2,
    "no-cond-assign": 0,
    "no-console": 0,
    "no-constant-condition": 0,
    "no-control-regex": 0,
    "no-debugger": 0,
    "no-delete-var": 0,
    "no-div-regex": 0,
    "no-dupe-keys": 0,
    "no-else-return": 0,
    "no-empty": 0,
    "no-empty-class": 0,
    "no-empty-label": 0,
    "no-eq-null": 0,
    "no-eval": 0,
    "no-ex-assign": 0,
    "no-extend-native": 0,
    "no-extra-boolean-cast": 0,
    "no-extra-parens": 0,
    "no-extra-semi": 0,
    "no-extra-strict": 0,
    "no-fallthrough": 0,
    "no-floating-decimal": 0,
    "no-func-assign": 0,
    "no-global-strict": 0,
    "no-implied-eval": 0,
    "no-inner-declarations": [0, "functions"],
    "no-invalid-regexp": 0,
    "no-iterator": 0,
    "no-label-var": 0,
    "no-labels": 0,
    "no-lone-blocks": 0,
    "no-lonely-if": 0,
    "no-loop-func": 0,
    "no-mixed-requires": [0, false],
    "no-multi-str": 0,
    "no-native-reassign": 0,
    "no-negated-in-lhs": 0,
    "no-nested-ternary": 0,
    "no-new": 0,
    "no-new-func": 0,
    "no-new-object": 0,
    "no-new-require": 0,
    "no-new-wrappers": 0,
    "no-obj-calls": 0,
    "no-octal": 0,
    "no-octal-escape": 0,
    "no-path-concat": 0,
    "no-plusplus": 0,
    "no-process-exit": 0,
    "no-proto": 0,
    "no-redeclare": 0,
    "no-regex-spaces": 0,
    "no-restricted-modules": 0,
    "no-return-assign": 0,
    "no-script-url": 0,
    "no-self-compare": 0,
    "no-sequences": 0,
    "no-shadow": 0,
    "no-shadow-restricted-names": 0,
    "no-spaced-func": 0,
    "no-space-before-semi": 0,
    "no-sparse-arrays": 0,
    "no-sync": 0,
    "no-ternary": 0,
    "no-undef": 2,
    "no-undef-init": 0,
    "no-underscore-dangle": 0,
    "no-unreachable": 0,
    "no-unused-expressions": 0,
    "no-unused-vars": [0, {"vars": "all", "args": "after-used"}],
    "no-use-before-define": 0,
    "no-warning-comments": [0, { "terms": ["todo", "fixme", "xxx"], "location": "start" }],
    "no-with": 0,
    "no-wrap-func": 0,
    "no-yoda": 0,

    "block-scoped-var": 0,
    "brace-style": [0, "1tbs"],
    "camelcase": 0,
    "complexity": [0, 11],
    "consistent-return": 0,
    "consistent-this": [0, "that"],
    "curly": [0, "all"],
    "default-case": 0,
    "dot-notation": 0,
    "eqeqeq": 0,
    "func-names": 0,
    "func-style": [0, "declaration"],
    "guard-for-in": 0,
    "max-depth": [0, 4],
    "max-len": [0, 80, 4],
    "max-nested-callbacks": [0, 2],
    "max-params": [0, 3],
    "max-statements": [0, 10],
    "handle-callback-err": 0,
    "new-cap": 0,
    "new-parens": 0,
    "one-var": 0,
    "quote-props": 0,
    "quotes": [0, "double"],
    "radix": 0,
    "semi": 0,
    "sort-vars": 0,
    "space-after-keywords": [0, "always"],
    "space-in-brackets": [0, "never"],
    "space-infix-ops": 0,
    "space-return-throw-case": 0,
    "space-unary-word-ops": 0,
    "strict": 0,
    "use-isnan": 0,
    "valid-jsdoc": 0,
    "valid-typeof": 0,
    "wrap-iife": 0,
    "wrap-regex": 0
  }
}
```

This works fine with 0.6.2 but with 0.7.1, none of the globals in the configuration file are parsed. The directory structure is like:

`root/some/directory/lot_of_js`

With `root/.eslintrc` and we run `eslint some/directory/lots_of_js` from root.
